title: Ay parindo dare zindan
body:
ay parindo dar e zindan se guzra na karo
ek yateema ko sar e shaam se sataya na karo
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aata hai har ek lamha madina usko
raas aaya na watan chod ke jeena usko
zakhm jo usko mile hai unhe taaza na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhti hai tumhe jab laut ke ghar jaate huwe
uski aankhon se ubhalte hai lahoo ke chashme
itna royi hai usay aur rulaaya na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ho azaad mubarak ho tumhe azaadi
qaid e zindan mein sakina hai magar faryadi
ek dukhe dil ko idhar aake dukhaya na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo zindan hai jahan qaid hai pyasi bacchi
ser o sehraab ho tum bujh na saki pyaas uski
raasta apna badal do idhar aaya na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap se pehle pehel chooti hai kamsin hai bahot
dekh kar tumko tadap jayegi mumkin hai bahot
abhi jao to teherne ka iraada na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumko maloom nahi kitni ghutan hai usko
dil bhi zakhmi hai safar ki bhi thakan hai usko
uski takleef mein ab aur izaafa na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
is yatema pe bahot tang hui hai dunya
tum jidhar chaahe chale jao badi hai dunya
qaid khane ke khareeb aa ke basera na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghair mumkin hai yateemi usay mehsoos na ho
aisi shamma hai ke jiska koi fanoos na ho
apne bacchon ka paron ka yahan saaya na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj tak qabre sakina par udaasi hai suroor
dil ye kehta hai wo bacchi abhi pyasi hai suroor
uspe rone ke siwa koi bhi nauha na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
author: Suroor Lakhnavi
